charteredChapters.name: The American University in Cairo (AUC) Optica Student Chapter
charteredChapters.advisorDepartment: School of Sciences and Engineering / Physics and Nanotechnology
charteredChapters.description: The first formally chartered Optica Student Chapter in Egypt. Hosted within the School of Sciences and Engineering at AUC New Cairo, the branch brings physics, optical engineering, and nanotechnology students together with visiting researchers and is undergoing executive reactivation.
highlights: First formally chartered Optica student chapter in Egypt, established in 2024.
Undergoing section-supported reactivation to reconstitute student leadership and activities.
Hosted Optica Traveling Lecturer seminars on metamaterials and silicon photonics.

pipelineChapters.name: Zewail City Optica Student Chapter
pipelineChapters.university: Zewail City of Science and Technology
pipelineChapters.campus: October Gardens Campus, 6th of October City
pipelineChapters.description: Second Optica Student Chapter initiative in Egypt, currently undergoing student organizer onboarding, faculty endorsement alignment, and founding charter preparation at Zewail City of Science and Technology in Giza.
highlights: Second Optica student chapter in formation within Egypt alongside the established AUC branch.
Student chartering team completing founding member registration and governance requirements.

charterRoadmap.title: Assemble Core Student Members
charterRoadmap.body: Gather at least five enrolled university students who share an active interest in optics, photonics, physics, or optical engineering.

charterRoadmap.title: Secure a Faculty Advisor
charterRoadmap.body: Confirm a departmental faculty member or researcher who holds, or agrees to obtain, an active Optica professional membership.

charterRoadmap.title: Adopt the Chapter Constitution
charterRoadmap.body: Use the official Optica Student Chapter constitution template to define core officer roles (President, Vice President, Secretary, and Treasurer).

charterRoadmap.title: Submit the Charter Petition
charterRoadmap.body: The Optica Egypt Local Section assists founding student teams in preparing and submitting the charter petition to Optica for formal approval and startup support.
